description:
Hyperlocal weather for the Karrantza/Ordunte valley and hunting season info
Ordunte is a native Android app for hyperlocal weather in the Karrantza / Ordunte valley (Carranza, Bizkaia). Motto: El tiempo del valle.

What it shows
• Valley forecast: glance header, temperature and sky, the next few hours, and an hourly temperature curve with rain bars.
• Measured AEMET warnings for the valley, with their own channel so they are not repeated.
• Hunting section: day card, legal window and regional closed seasons. This is informational only. It is not a hunting permit and it does not replace any official licence.
• Home-screen widget and periodic sync.
• Optional beach camera (La Salvé) resolved from a public stream page.

Where the data comes from
• Forecast, warnings, air and tides use Open-Meteo, AEMET and IHM directly. Those requests do not go through nomad.
• Hunting seasons, the valley Bresser station and the Cerroja ridge reading need nomad.debian.link. Without that service those sections stay empty or show a network error (F-Droid TetheredNet). The app does not invent a temperature to fill the gap.

No client token or Euskalmet key is baked into the package. A release build only needs the Android SDK path.
